reports.evidence: Key is 20 and independent solver also got 20; stored solution incorrectly gave 40 cm, so solution is wrong.
reports.student_reply: Hey! The correct side length is 20 cm. The answer key is right – the solution had a typo and gave 40 cm. After fixing the calculation (using buoyancy before and after removing the 800 g mass) you get a = 20 cm. Thanks for catching it!
